items.excerpt: A practical breakdown of the three recurring jobs — metadata, pitch copy and content repurposing — that independent artists can hand to AI without giving up creative control.
items.title: The Three Tasks AI Can Take Off Every Artist's Plate

items.excerpt: Roland shipped Melody Flip, an AI melody-generation plug-in built with Sony CSL that analyses a reference track's key, chords and mood, then offers ~300 creative palettes of new melodic ideas exportable as MIDI or audio.
items.title: Roland Releases Melody Flip, an AI Melody-Generation Plug-In for DAWs

items.excerpt: Suno pulled an ad campaign featuring Mary J. Blige after the singer said she never approved it, a reminder of how fast AI-music marketing can outrun artist consent.
items.title: Suno pulls unapproved Mary J. Blige ad campaign citing deception

items.excerpt: Working engineers and producers debate where AI actually helps in a session — stem repair, comping, mastering assistance — and where it erodes the craft decisions that define a record.
items.title: Pros Discuss AI In Music Production

items.excerpt: As feeds fill with AI slop, Hypebot argues the flood is pushing listeners back toward human-made work and giving craft-forward artists a new positioning advantage.
items.title: Is AI Slop Giving Artists and Creators a New Life?

items.excerpt: JO:LA Labs launches Roster, an AI 'business operating system' that automates the admin layer around artist teams — royalties, release planning and reporting — so managers spend more time on creative work.
items.title: JO:LA Labs launches AI ‘business operating system’ Roster

items.excerpt: The US administration filed in support of OpenAI's fair-use position, a move MBW argues could reshape the training-data fights that music creators have brought against Suno, Udio and Anthropic.
items.title: Donald Trump’s administration just sided with OpenAI in a key ‘fair use’ case. Here’s what it means for music’s fight with Anthropic and Suno.

items.excerpt: Jason Isbell, David Lowery and other songwriters filed a class action alleging Suno coded its model to extract musicians' identities and vocal likenesses without consent.
items.title: David Lowery Files Suno Lawsuit Alleging Identity Rights Violations

items.excerpt: Udio answered Sony Music's copyright suit by leaning on fair use while acknowledging its training corpus, setting up a test of how licensed AI music platforms must document their data.
items.title: Udio Fires Back Against Supersized Sony Music Copyright Lawsuit

items.excerpt: Synthtopia digs into how Dreamtonics' Instrument X swaps multi-gigabyte sample libraries for neural acoustic synthesis, promising expressive orchestral parts from a tiny install footprint.
items.title: Dreamtonics Instrument X Replaces Big Sample Libraries With Neural Acoustics

items.excerpt: Attack reviews Yamaha's Creator Pass subscription, which bundles Output Arcade, LANDR sample access, AI-assisted mastering and a DAW bundle into a single monthly on-ramp for bedroom producers.
items.title: Yamaha Creator Pass Review: A Subscription Built For The Budding Bedroom Producer

items.excerpt: ElevenLabs added Composer to ElevenMusic, a section-by-section song editor that lets creators regenerate a verse or chorus in place instead of rerolling a whole track.
items.title: ElevenMusic Launches Composer 'Section-by-Section Song Editor'
